senses.en: Measuring and recording the shape and size of land.

ex.en: Surveying the border took several years.
ex.zh: 勘测边界花了好几年。

senses.en: Finding a position by measuring angles from two known points.

ex.en: Triangulation was used to map India.
ex.zh: 人们用三角测量法绘制了印度地图。

senses.en: A person who studies geography.

ex.en: The geographer studied how cities grow.
ex.zh: 这位地理学家研究城市如何发展。

senses.en: relating to the later Stone Age, when farming began

ex.en: The museum has neolithic tools.
ex.zh: 博物馆藏有新石器时代的工具。

ex.en: The Neolithic period saw the spread of farming, permanent villages and polished stone tools.
ex.zh: 新石器时代见证了农业、定居村落和磨制石器的传播。

tip: neo-（新）+ lithic（石）；Paleolithic 旧石器时代。

senses.en: Relating to data tied to locations on the earth.

ex.en: Geospatial data tracks deforestation.
ex.zh: 地理空间数据追踪森林砍伐。

senses.en: The scientific study of minerals.

ex.en: Mineralogy helps identify valuable ores.
ex.zh: 矿物学有助于识别有价值的矿石。

senses.en: The study of rocks and how they form.

ex.en: Petrology reveals the history of a mountain.
ex.zh: 岩石学揭示了一座山的历史。

senses.en: The study of the chemical makeup of the earth.

ex.en: Geochemistry tracks elements through rocks and water.
ex.zh: 地球化学追踪元素在岩石和水中的迁移。

senses.en: A scientist who studies volcanoes.

ex.en: Volcanologists monitor the gases from the crater.
ex.zh: 火山学家监测火山口喷出的气体。

senses.en: Arrange or style hair.

ex.en: She learned to hairdress by practising on a mannequin.
ex.zh: 她通过在人头模型上练习学会了做发型。

ex.en: People who learn to hairdress professionally may develop practical skills that support employment in local service industries.
ex.zh: 学习专业美发的人可以培养实用技能，从而在当地服务行业就业。

tip: 日常说做发型用 style hair；美发行业用 hairdressing。
note: 罕见动词，不宜作常用名词；“美发”通常用 hairdressing。

senses.en: The study of volcanoes.

ex.en: Advances in volcanology have saved many lives.
ex.zh: 火山学的进步挽救了许多生命。

senses.en: Volcanic activity.

ex.en: Volcanism shaped the islands of Hawaii.
ex.zh: 火山作用塑造了夏威夷群岛。

senses.en: Relating to magma.

ex.en: Magmatic heat drives the hot springs.
ex.zh: 岩浆的热量驱动着温泉。

senses.en: Formed from magma that cooled underground; annoyingly disturbing.

ex.en: Granite is an intrusive igneous rock.
ex.zh: 花岗岩是一种侵入性火成岩。

senses.en: Formed from lava that cooled on the surface.

ex.en: Basalt is an extrusive rock.
ex.zh: 玄武岩是喷出岩。

senses.en: impossible to take away or transfer to someone else

ex.en: Our teacher explained why everyone has certain inalienable rights.
ex.zh: 老师解释了为什么每个人都享有某些不可剥夺的权利。

ex.en: Access to basic education should be recognised as an inalienable right, regardless of a child's background.
ex.zh: 无论儿童的背景如何，接受基础教育都应被承认为不可剥夺的权利。

col: an inalienable right to freedom｜不可剥夺的自由权
tip: 正式用语，主要修饰rights，强调不能剥夺或转让。

senses.en: Magma forced into existing rock; an unwelcome entry.

ex.en: A granite intrusion forms the core of the mountain.
ex.zh: 花岗岩侵入体构成了山的核心。

senses.en: A body of igneous rock that cooled deep underground.

ex.en: Erosion exposed the pluton.
ex.zh: 侵蚀使深成岩体暴露出来。

senses.en: A very large mass of igneous rock formed underground.

ex.en: The Sierra Nevada is a huge batholith.
ex.zh: 内华达山脉是一个巨大的岩基。

senses.en: A sheet of rock cutting across layers; a wall built to hold back water.

ex.en: A dark dike cuts through the pale granite.
ex.zh: 一道深色岩墙切过浅色花岗岩。

senses.en: A flat sheet of rock between layers; the shelf at the bottom of a window.

ex.en: A sill of basalt lies between the sandstone beds.
ex.zh: 一层玄武岩岩床夹在砂岩层之间。

senses.en: the weight of packaging or a container without its contents
adjust a scale to exclude the weight of a container

ex.en: Tare the scale before adding flour to the bowl.
ex.zh: 往碗里加面粉前，先把秤去皮归零。

ex.en: Accurate tare measurements allow food producers to calculate product weight without including the packaging.
ex.zh: 准确测量皮重，能让食品生产商计算不含包装的产品重量。

col: tare the scale｜将秤去皮归零
tip: 皮重是容器重量；净重等于毛重减去皮重。

senses.en: Rock formed from compacted volcanic ash.

ex.en: Ancient homes were carved into soft tuff.
ex.zh: 古代民居凿建在松软的凝灰岩中。

senses.en: Rock fragments thrown into the air by a volcano.

ex.en: A layer of tephra covered the fields.
ex.zh: 一层火山碎屑覆盖了田野。

senses.en: A hard mineral compound found in sand and quartz.

ex.en: Glass is made mainly from silica.
ex.zh: 玻璃主要由二氧化硅制成。

senses.en: A mineral containing silicon and oxygen.

ex.en: Most rocks are made of silicate minerals.
ex.zh: 大多数岩石由硅酸盐矿物构成。

senses.en: Rich in magnesium and iron, and usually dark in color.

ex.en: Basalt is a mafic rock.
ex.zh: 玄武岩是镁铁质岩石。

senses.en: A solid block of metal cast for storage or processing.

ex.en: The worker lifted a shiny ingot with heavy tongs.
ex.zh: 工人用沉重的钳子夹起了一块闪亮的金属锭。

ex.en: Recycled aluminium can be cast into ingots before being processed into components for vehicles and buildings.
ex.zh: 回收铝可以先铸成锭，再加工成车辆和建筑所需的部件。

tip: 指铸成块的金属，不专指铁或纯铁。

senses.en: Rich in silica and light in color.

ex.en: Felsic magma is thick and sticky.
ex.zh: 长英质岩浆黏稠。

senses.en: A green mineral common in the earth's mantle.

ex.en: Green sand beaches contain olivine.
ex.zh: 绿色沙滩含有橄榄石。

senses.en: A hard red mineral used as a gem.

ex.en: Garnets are found in metamorphic rocks.
ex.zh: 石榴石出现在变质岩中。

senses.en: A durable mineral used to date ancient rocks.

ex.en: The oldest zircon crystals are 4.4 billion years old.
ex.zh: 最古老的锆石晶体有44亿年历史。

senses.en: A volcanic rock that sometimes contains diamonds.

ex.en: Diamonds are mined from kimberlite pipes.
ex.zh: 钻石开采自金伯利岩管。

senses.en: containing a promise, especially a written promise to pay

ex.en: She signed a promissory note before borrowing the money.
ex.zh: 她借钱前签署了一张本票。

ex.en: A promissory note provides written evidence of debt, helping lenders establish their legal right to repayment.
ex.zh: 本票提供书面的债务凭证，帮助出借人确立依法获得偿还的权利。

tip: 主要用于法律金融语境，常见搭配为promissory note。

senses.en: A precious stone cut and polished for jewelry.

ex.en: Rubies and sapphires are valuable gemstones.
ex.zh: 红宝石和蓝宝石是贵重宝石。

senses.en: A hollow rock lined with crystals.

ex.en: He cracked open a geode full of purple crystals.
ex.zh: 他敲开了一个满是紫色晶体的晶洞。

senses.en: A hard stone with colored bands.

ex.en: The agate was polished into a pendant.
ex.zh: 这块玛瑙被打磨成了吊坠。

senses.en: A hard, fine-grained rock made of silica.

ex.en: Early tools were made from chert.
ex.zh: 早期工具用燧石制成。

senses.en: A hard gray stone that makes sparks when struck.

ex.en: Stone Age people shaped flint into blades.
ex.zh: 石器时代的人把燧石打制成刀片。

senses.en: Caring mainly about money rather than other considerations
A soldier paid to fight for a foreign army or group

ex.en: His mercenary attitude spoiled our plans for the charity.
ex.zh: 他唯利是图的态度破坏了我们的慈善计划。

ex.en: A purely mercenary approach to healthcare risks placing financial returns above the needs of patients.
ex.zh: 对医疗服务采取纯粹逐利的做法，可能会使经济回报凌驾于患者需求之上。

tip: 形容词带贬义，强调只看重金钱；作名词指雇佣兵。

senses.en: A hard green stone used for jewelry and carving.

ex.en: The jade carving is over 2,000 years old.
ex.zh: 这件玉雕有两千多年历史。

senses.en: A precious stone, often yellow or blue.

ex.en: She wore a ring set with a topaz.
ex.zh: 她戴着一枚镶黄玉的戒指。

senses.en: A clear, usually blue, precious stone.

ex.en: The crown is set with sapphires.
ex.zh: 王冠上镶着蓝宝石。

senses.en: A deep red precious stone.

ex.en: Rubies are a form of corundum.
ex.zh: 红宝石是刚玉的一种。

senses.en: A bright green precious stone.

ex.en: Colombia produces fine emeralds.
ex.zh: 哥伦比亚出产优质祖母绿。

senses.en: Acting as though you are better than other people.

ex.en: The customer gave the waiter a haughty look.
ex.zh: 那位顾客傲慢地看了服务员一眼。

ex.en: A haughty attitude among senior managers can discourage employees from sharing ideas and reporting problems openly.
ex.zh: 高层管理者的傲慢态度会使员工不愿分享想法或公开反映问题。

tip: 含贬义，强调自视高人一等，不等于自信。

senses.en: A reddish mineral that is an important iron ore.

ex.en: Hematite gives Mars its red color.
ex.zh: 赤铁矿让火星呈现红色。

senses.en: A black magnetic iron mineral.

ex.en: Lodestones are pieces of magnetite.
ex.zh: 天然磁石就是磁铁矿块。

senses.en: The main ore from which aluminum is made.

ex.en: Australia mines large amounts of bauxite.
ex.zh: 澳大利亚开采大量铝土矿。

senses.en: A green copper mineral with banded patterns.

ex.en: Malachite was ground to make green paint.
ex.zh: 孔雀石被磨碎制成绿色颜料。

senses.en: A deposit of sand or gravel containing gold or other minerals.

ex.en: Miners panned for gold in placer deposits.
ex.zh: 矿工在砂矿中淘金。

senses.en: To sit or lie in a relaxed, lazy way.
To hang loosely, especially the head or tongue.

ex.en: We lolled on the sofa after our long walk.
ex.zh: 长途散步后，我们懒洋洋地躺在沙发上。

ex.en: Comfortable public seating encourages visitors to loll in the shade rather than leave parks during hot weather.
ex.zh: 舒适的公共座椅让游客在炎热天气里愿意懒散地靠坐在树荫下，而不是离开公园。

col: loll on the sofa｜懒洋洋地躺在沙发上
tongue lolling out｜舌头耷拉在外
tip: 常接about或around，强调姿势松散、懒洋洋。

senses.en: A vein of metal ore in rock.

ex.en: The miners struck a rich silver lode.
ex.zh: 矿工们找到了一条富银矿脉。

senses.en: A person who searches for gold or other minerals.

ex.en: Prospectors rushed to California in 1849.
ex.zh: 1849年探矿者涌向加利福尼亚。

senses.en: Searching an area for minerals or oil.

ex.en: Prospecting in the desert is hot, hard work.
ex.zh: 在沙漠中探矿是又热又苦的工作。

senses.en: A test of the quality of a metal or ore.

ex.en: The assay showed the ore was rich in gold.
ex.zh: 化验显示这种矿石含金量很高。

senses.en: Extracting metal from ore by heating it.

ex.en: Smelting copper began over 7,000 years ago.
ex.zh: 冶炼铜始于七千多年前。

senses.en: The waste left after ore has been processed.

ex.en: Toxic tailings leaked into the river.
ex.zh: 有毒尾矿泄漏到河里。

senses.en: The choice and style of words in speech or writing.
The way someone pronounces words, especially how clearly.

ex.en: Her formal diction sounded strange at our relaxed picnic.
ex.zh: 在我们轻松的野餐聚会上，她正式的措辞听起来很不协调。

ex.en: Writers often adapt their diction to make complex scientific ideas accessible to a wider audience.
ex.zh: 作者常会调整措辞，让更广泛的读者能够理解复杂的科学概念。

tip: 既可指用词风格，也可指吐字是否清晰。

senses.en: Cutting stone from the ground.

ex.en: Quarrying left a deep hole in the hill.
ex.zh: 采石在山上留下了一个深坑。

senses.en: Igneous rock with large crystals in a fine-grained base.

ex.en: Roman emperors prized purple porphyry.
ex.zh: 罗马皇帝珍视紫色斑岩。

senses.en: Dark volcanic rock full of holes.

ex.en: The cinder cone is made of red scoria.
ex.zh: 火山渣锥由红色火山渣构成。

senses.en: Describing gentle eruptions of runny lava; expressing feelings freely.

ex.en: Hawaiian volcanoes have effusive eruptions.
ex.zh: 夏威夷火山的喷发是溢流式的。

senses.en: The study of heat, energy and work.

ex.en: The laws of thermodynamics govern engines.
ex.zh: 热力学定律支配着发动机。

senses.en: a part of a rock formation visible above the ground

ex.en: We climbed a rocky outcrop.
ex.zh: 我们爬上一处裸露的岩石。

ex.en: Geologists study outcrops along road cuts because they reveal layers of rock that are normally hidden underground.
ex.zh: 地质学家研究公路边坡上的露头，因为它们显露出平时埋在地下的岩层。

senses.en: Relating to heat and energy transfer.

ex.en: The thermodynamic efficiency of the engine is low.
ex.zh: 这台发动机的热效率很低。

senses.en: A measure of disorder in a system.

ex.en: Entropy in a closed system always increases.
ex.zh: 封闭系统中的熵总是增加。

senses.en: The total heat content of a system.

ex.en: The reaction releases enthalpy as heat.
ex.zh: 该反应以热的形式释放焓。

senses.en: A force that causes something to rotate.

ex.en: A longer wrench gives more torque.
ex.zh: 更长的扳手能提供更大的扭矩。

senses.en: Moving or pulling toward the center.

ex.en: Centripetal force keeps a satellite in orbit.
ex.zh: 向心力使卫星保持在轨道上。

senses.en: An extremely strong feeling of joy and delight.

ex.en: The children watched the dancing dolphins in rapture.
ex.zh: 孩子们欣喜万分地看着海豚跃动。

ex.en: The rapture experienced during live performances helps explain why audiences continue to value shared cultural events.
ex.zh: 现场演出带来的强烈喜悦，有助于解释观众为何依然珍视共同参与的文化活动。

col: go into raptures over｜对……欣喜若狂
tip: 语气强于happiness，常带文学色彩。

senses.en: An object thrown or shot through the air.

ex.en: A projectile follows a curved path.
ex.zh: 抛射体沿曲线路径运动。

senses.en: The maximum height of a wave from its center.

ex.en: Louder sounds have a greater amplitude.
ex.zh: 声音越大，振幅越大。

senses.en: Relating to musical harmony, or to a frequency that is a multiple of a base frequency.

ex.en: A guitar string vibrates at several harmonic frequencies.
ex.zh: 吉他弦以几个谐波频率振动。

senses.en: The science of sound, or the sound qualities of a room.

ex.en: The concert hall has excellent acoustics.
ex.zh: 这个音乐厅的音响效果极佳。

senses.en: Relating to sound too high for humans to hear.

ex.en: Bats emit ultrasonic calls.
ex.zh: 蝙蝠发出超声波叫声。

senses.en: Making something false seem true or something unreal seem real.

ex.en: The mirror created a delusive impression of extra space.
ex.zh: 这面镜子造成了空间更大的错觉。

ex.en: Early economic gains may create a delusive sense of security if governments ignore underlying weaknesses in public finances.
ex.zh: 如果政府忽视公共财政的潜在弱点，早期经济收益可能造成虚假的安全感。

col: delusive sense of security｜虚假的安全感
tip: 较正式且少见；日常多用misleading或deceptive。

senses.en: Sound too low for humans to hear.

ex.en: Elephants communicate using infrasound.
ex.zh: 大象用次声波交流。

senses.en: Relating to the change in frequency when a source moves toward or away from you.

ex.en: The doppler effect makes a siren's pitch drop as it passes.
ex.zh: 多普勒效应使警笛驶过时音调降低。

senses.en: The spreading of waves around obstacles or through openings.

ex.en: Diffraction lets you hear sound around corners.
ex.zh: 衍射让你能听到拐角那边的声音。

senses.en: Restricting light waves to one direction; division into opposing groups.

ex.en: Sunglasses use polarization to cut glare.
ex.zh: 太阳镜利用偏振减少眩光。

senses.en: The smallest amount of energy; relating to quantum physics.

ex.en: Quantum physics describes the behavior of atoms.
ex.zh: 量子物理描述原子的行为。

senses.en: having soft, loose flesh rather than firm muscles
lacking strength, effectiveness, or clear structure

ex.en: He felt his muscles had grown flabby during recovery.
ex.zh: 他觉得自己的肌肉在康复期间变得松弛了。

ex.en: An essay with flabby arguments may fail to persuade readers, even when its topic is important.
ex.zh: 即使主题重要，论证松散无力的文章也可能无法说服读者。

tip: 多指肌肉松弛；形容文章时指松散无力，语气贬义。

senses.en: A positively charged particle in an atom's nucleus.

ex.en: Hydrogen has one proton.
ex.zh: 氢有一个质子。

senses.en: The release of radiation from unstable atoms.

ex.en: Marie Curie studied radioactivity.
ex.zh: 居里夫人研究放射性。

senses.en: The time it takes for half of a radioactive substance to decay.

ex.en: Carbon-14 has a half-life of about 5,730 years.
ex.zh: 碳14的半衰期约为5730年。

senses.en: Able to remove electrons from atoms.

ex.en: X-rays are a form of ionizing radiation.
ex.zh: X射线是一种电离辐射。

senses.en: Relating to ions.

ex.en: Salt is held together by ionic bonds.
ex.zh: 盐由离子键结合在一起。

senses.en: a device measuring the total distance a vehicle has travelled

ex.en: The odometer showed how far we had driven.
ex.zh: 里程表显示了我们已经行驶的距离。

ex.en: When purchasing a used vehicle, consumers should check its odometer reading alongside its maintenance records.
ex.zh: 购买二手车时，消费者应将里程表读数与保养记录一并核查。

tip: 记录累计里程；speedometer显示即时车速。

senses.en: Describing a bond in which atoms share electrons.

ex.en: Water molecules have covalent bonds.
ex.zh: 水分子含有共价键。

senses.en: A chemical element that is not a metal, such as oxygen.

ex.en: Carbon is a nonmetal.
ex.zh: 碳是非金属。

senses.en: An element with properties of both metals and nonmetals.

ex.en: Silicon is a metalloid.
ex.zh: 硅是类金属。

senses.en: A reaction in which a substance combines with oxygen or loses electrons.

ex.en: Rust is caused by oxidation.
ex.zh: 生锈是氧化造成的。

senses.en: A reaction involving both oxidation and reduction.

ex.en: Batteries rely on redox reactions.
ex.zh: 电池依靠氧化还原反应。

senses.en: To strongly urge someone to do something.

ex.en: Our coach exhorted us to keep trying until the end.
ex.zh: 教练力劝我们坚持努力到最后。

ex.en: Public health campaigns exhort citizens to exercise regularly, but affordable facilities are also needed to support lasting change.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传敦促市民经常锻炼，但要支持持久的改变，也需要价格亲民的设施。

col: exhort someone to act｜敦促某人行动
exhort citizens to vote｜敦促公民投票
tip: 正式用词：exhort sb to do，不只是提出忠告。

senses.en: Speeding up a chemical reaction with a catalyst.

ex.en: Enzymes work by catalysis.
ex.zh: 酶通过催化作用起效。

senses.en: A substance used to cause or test for a chemical reaction.

ex.en: Add the reagent drop by drop.
ex.zh: 逐滴加入试剂。

senses.en: A substance that takes part in a chemical reaction.

ex.en: The reactants are consumed during the reaction.
ex.zh: 反应过程中反应物被消耗。

senses.en: A substance dissolved in a liquid.

ex.en: Salt is the solute in seawater.
ex.zh: 盐是海水中的溶质。

senses.en: Unable to dissolve; impossible to solve.

ex.en: Sand is insoluble in water.
ex.zh: 沙不溶于水。
